style.vernacular: A red-brick city on a high plateau: exposed brick (ladrillo) apartment blocks, houses and institutional buildings in rust-red; whitewashed colonial and republican houses with clay-tile roofs in La Candelaria and the old towns; concrete and glass towers in the north and the international district; fibre-cement and corrugated roofs on peripheral self-built neighbourhoods; eucalyptus, pine and broadleaf street trees under a cool grey sky.
style.ornament: Neo-Mudejar brickwork with horseshoe arches, alfiz frames and brick lattice (Santamaria bullring); whitewashed colonial walls with exposed timber, clay roof tiles and iron fences; Rogelio Salmona-style brick geometry; wall murals and graffiti; blank commercial signboards.
